review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; prospective design self-review
review.decision: Cover precise publication ordering and upstream source availability from independent review
review.notes: Reviewed the two #1930 blocking findings and normal queue semantics. Drive one deterministic in-drain producer hook. Simulate missing source trees with isolated paths. No production probe.

cases.description: A request published during a Mac drain is admitted against a subsequent snapshot
cases.setup: Temporary queue, old empty snapshot, fake macOS notification center with a producer hook between state reading and enumeration under the old implementation.
cases.action: Publish new scope then its JSON request from the hook; drain again, then change the snapshot before returning a late posting callback.
cases.expected: The new request is submitted exactly once; source-approved removal before callback withdraws it without requiring another external poll.

cases.description: Failed snapshot publication does not consume an alert opportunity
cases.setup: Make the scoped snapshot location unreadable in a temporary HOME and capture real notification requests with a fake desktop sink.
cases.action: Publish a new actionable alert, recover the snapshot location, rescan immediately and again during cooldown.
cases.expected: No orphan request is issued while state cannot publish. Repair makes the still-active alert immediately eligible once; no duplicate follows.

cases.description: Missing source trees preserve live alerts while exact verified endings withdraw them
cases.setup: Temporary HOME with a persisted workspace decision, ordinary new empty workspace, two canonical relay files and their outstanding observations.
cases.action: Temporarily move records.json and the relay directory out of view, restore them, then resolve the workspace decision and one precise relay file.
cases.expected: The active workspace cannot be implicitly initialized from an outage and the relay notices remain live while their parent is unavailable. A genuinely new workspace can initialize. Exact confirmed resolution only retracts its own notice. No delivery intent is executed.
